title: Reserve Officer

why: the blocks sum to 16.0-16.5; the catalog states 16.0-16.0

outcomes: Articulate the broad requirements of balancing law enforcement with individual liberties.

Adopt proper procedures related to due process and ethics, including routine patrol response, vehicle pullovers, crime scene forensics, officer safety, and preservation of evidence.
